text:
{collection}.{field}: the config of {type_id} changes.
The config is part of the type's merge rule: members would merge existing values differently.
Add a new field with the new config instead, and deprecate {collection}.{field}.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a plugin field's config changes, appears or disappears.
